expected_behavior_change: SMT ordering adopts a denser queue-catalog-receipt hierarchy while reusing existing view models and actions.
Unavailable checkout benefits explain that they are not connected instead of appearing silently disabled.
Cash quick keys include HKD 20 and the decimal keypad key now sends the value printed on the key.
Checkout shows an explicit final payment review before invoking the existing confirm action.
The low-frequency More entry is visually separated as a top hamburger control without changing routing.
non_goals: No Order, Pricing, Payment, Refund, Fulfillment, Print, Provider or Admin authority change.
No runtime endpoint, payload, persistence, idempotency or canonical readback change.
No implementation of missing ETA, customer cutoff, student discount or other unbound product capability.
No merge, deploy, production routing, OTA or hostname cutover.
